required_review_questions: Does a one-model gpt-oss-120b candidate population still answer the intended H3 feasibility question, and how must claims be narrowed?
Are batch-level provenance groups and support thresholds still justified under the single-model response process?
Does the Docker isolation design keep the full probe bank and expected values outside the candidate filesystem and process?
Do the anonymous endpoint limits and resume semantics preserve the fixed batch schedule and prevent silent provider or prompt changes?
Are the original instrument, saturation cutoff, PASS/WEAK/FAIL thresholds and futility checkpoints unchanged and consistently implemented?
